title: Machine learning guides a low-precious-metal RWGS catalyst
summary: An iterative machine-learning-guided campaign optimized precious-metal and additive compositions and support over 35 prediction–experiment cycles. The authors report a low-loading Pt–Ru–Pd catalyst that outperformed a commercial benchmark and their earlier high-PGM design in the reported reverse water–gas shift assay. This is a laboratory catalyst result, not demonstrated industrial performance.
ai_technology: Machine-learning-guided iterative catalyst composition and support optimization

evidence.tested: The publisher article reports the 35-cycle campaign and its best low-PGM catalyst outperforming the stated commercial and earlier high-PGM comparators.
evidence.unknown: The result is specific to the reported assay; scale-up and industrial operation are not established.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning-guided predictions prioritize PGM/additive compositions and support for iterative experimental testing.

source_review.scope: Publisher indexed primary article text including author affiliations, article history and abstract/result; full-text access remains publisher-limited.
